h1.en: Output and distance decide whether the B500S-83D Two-Stage Structure Pump row fits
h1.zh: 输送量和距离决定B500S-83D 两级结构泵这一行是否合适

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the B500S-83D Two-Stage Structure Pump at /products/b500s-83d-two-stage-pump. Copy only the printed cells: Model B500S-83D; Type Two-stage structure pump, manual / electric; Motor Power 7.5 kW; Rated Voltage 380 V; Delivery Height 5 m; Horizontal Delivery Distance 5 m; Boom Short boom on the compact unit, not a truck-mounted placing boom; Applicable Materials Sand and small stone, 5–16 mm; Delivery Hose Standard; Dimensions (L×W×H) 915 × 550 × 550 mm; Net Weight 280 kg. For transport, copy Dimensions (L×W×H) is 915 × 550 × 550 mm and Net Weight is 280 kg. This page does not print a theoretical output. Do not invent m³/h. Ask Xingtai which listed machine matches the rate you need. The printed distance row or rows: Horizontal Delivery Distance 5 m. Name horizontal and vertical metres, and name which row you mean. A distance row is not a stone-size cell. The printed power cell is 7.5 kW. Write the site supply next to it: voltage and frequency for an electric row, or diesel if the cell says diesel. Do not swap in a figure from another page. This page does not print a maximum aggregate or particle size. Send the size anyway, and ask Xingtai whether this listed part or machine accepts it. OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/b500s-83d-two-stage-pump. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print. No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai. The photograph on this note is a content image from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Power_trowel. It shows: Walk-behind power trowel with a petrol engine, handlebars and a round blade guard. It is a reference picture for the inquiry topic. It is not a Hebei Pinjin Machinery nameplate, not a quotation, and not an export case.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把B500S-83D 两级结构泵列在 /products/b500s-83d-two-stage-pump。只抄已印格子：型号 B500S-83D; 型式 两级结构泵，手动 / 电动; 电机功率 7.5 kW; 额定电压 380 V; 垂直输送高度 5 m; 水平输送距离 5 m; 臂架 本机短臂架，不是车载布料杆; 适用材料 砂与小石，5–16 mm; 输送胶管 标准; 外形尺寸 915 × 550 × 550 mm; 整机重量 280 kg。运输请抄外形尺寸是 915 × 550 × 550 mm，整机重量是 280 kg。这一页没有印理论输送量。不要自编 m³/h。向邢台问哪一条已列机型对得上你要的产量。已印距离行：水平输送距离 5 m。询盘写明水平米数、垂直米数，并点明是哪一行。距离行不是石子粒径。已印动力是 7.5 kW。旁边写上现场条件：电动行写电压和频率，格子写柴油就写柴油。不要换成另一页上的数字。这一页没有印最大骨料或粒径。仍然把粒径发给邢台，问这一已列配件或机器是否接受。OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/b500s-83d-two-stage-pump 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。这篇配图是 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Power_trowel 页面里的内容图片。画面主体：手扶抹光机，带汽油机、把手和圆形护圈。它只作询盘主题的参考。它不是河北品锦机械的铭牌，不是报价单，也不是出口案例。

body.en: Put /products/b500s-83d-two-stage-pump in the subject. Leave any cell the page does not print empty.
body.zh: 主题里写上 /products/b500s-83d-two-stage-pump。已公布的格子是：型号 B500S-83D; 型式 两级结构泵，手动 / 电动; 电机功率 7.5 kW; 额定电压 380 V; 垂直输送高度 5 m; 水平输送距离 5 m; 臂架 本机短臂架，不是车载布料杆; 适用材料 砂与小石，5–16 mm; 输送胶管 标准; 外形尺寸 915 × 550 × 550 mm; 整机重量 280 kg。页面没有印的格子保持空白。

heading.en: Output, distance, power and particle size
heading.zh: 输送量、距离、动力和粒径

body.en: This page does not print a theoretical output. Do not invent m³/h. Ask Xingtai which listed machine matches the rate you need. The printed distance row or rows: Horizontal Delivery Distance 5 m. Name horizontal and vertical metres, and name which row you mean. A distance row is not a stone-size cell. The printed power cell is 7.5 kW. Write the site supply next to it: voltage and frequency for an electric row, or diesel if the cell says diesel. Do not swap in a figure from another page. This page does not print a maximum aggregate or particle size. Send the size anyway, and ask Xingtai whether this listed part or machine accepts it.
body.zh: 这一页没有印理论输送量。不要自编 m³/h。向邢台问哪一条已列机型对得上你要的产量。已印距离行：水平输送距离 5 m。询盘写明水平米数、垂直米数，并点明是哪一行。距离行不是石子粒径。已印动力是 7.5 kW。旁边写上现场条件：电动行写电压和频率，格子写柴油就写柴油。不要换成另一页上的数字。这一页没有印最大骨料或粒径。仍然把粒径发给邢台，问这一已列配件或机器是否接受。

heading.en: What to ask Xingtai instead of guessing
heading.zh: 该问邢台，而不是自己猜

body.en: OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/b500s-83d-two-stage-pump. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print. Also send country and purchase timing as facts about your order. Do not turn them into a promised lead time or an export-country list. No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai.
body.zh: OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/b500s-83d-two-stage-pump 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。同时把国家和采购时间作为订单事实发来。不要把它们写成承诺交期，也不要写成出口国名单。产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。
